title: Inspect and replace the air filter
summary: Open the airbox, check the element and fit a new one when it is dirty. A clogged filter costs power and fuel.
parts: Air filter element for your model

steps.text: Remove the side cover or seat panel to reach the airbox, then remove the airbox cover screws.
Lift out the element and note which way it faces.
Hold it up to a light. If you can't see light through it, or it is oily, torn or caked with dust, replace it.
steps.caution: Most scooter filters are viscous paper. Don't wash or blow them out with air; that ruins the filter.

steps.text: Wipe dust out of the airbox with a damp rag, keeping dirt away from the intake opening.
Fit the new element the same way round and check it seats evenly on every edge.
Refit the cover and screws. Drain the airbox check hose underneath, if your bike has one.
